__intro: Thirty days of TeamBalance. Then, | and now.
This was TeamBalance on the twelfth of O: This was TeamBalance, on the twelfth of October.
Signing in meant waiting for an email.
Today, a passkey signs you in with one t: Today, a passkey signs you in with one tap.
The events page, a month ago...
...and now. The same team, the same matc: ...and now. The same team, | the same match.
The next event takes the colour of its t: The next event takes the colour of its type, | and the header names the page.
The Money tab was a promise.
Now, it's the team's Bunk account.
The balance, the pot over time, and how: The balance, the pot over time, | and how many beers it buys.
A payment without a member? An admin ass: A payment without a member? An admin assigns it.
The next payment like it, links itself.
And Toppers ranks who put in the most.
Back on Events, open the match.
The league moved it by an hour. TeamBala: The league moved it by an hour. TeamBalance reads the Nayvobo feed, | and noticed.
One tap takes over the new time.
The profile was one long page.
The whole app turns Dutch, and so do the: The whole app turns Dutch, | and so do the emails.
Not everything shows. Hibernate is gone:: Not everything shows. Hibernate is gone:
sixteen repositories moved to jOOQ, one: sixteen repositories moved to jook, | one at a time.
Stored secrets are now bound to their te: Stored secrets are now bound to their team.
Copied to another team, they do not decr: Copied to another team, they do not decrypt.
The money pool reads the real Bunk A P I.
Cached, with timeouts, and a pause when: Cached, with timeouts, | and a pause when Bunk says slow down.
A hundred and forty-eight commits in thi: A hundred and forty-eight commits, in thirty days.
Tests run in parallel, staging deploys o: Tests run in parallel, staging deploys on demand, | and anyone can try the demo team.
__outro: Try it today! Top up the pot, add a passkey, or pick your language. See you at TeamBalance dot N L!
